title: Continuation material identity and speciation qualification
question: What additional material identity or speciation can be assigned to M_surface_NH4_non_aqueous_continuation without inventing unsupported model semantics?

evidence_result.user_guide: No explicit dry nonaqueous surface residual identity or rewetting identity is documented.
evidence_result.revision53_source: No audited existing NH4 route provides an unchanged continuation-state identity.
evidence_result.reason: Outside literature cannot prove that the existing continuation owner is a particular material unless a source-to-state mapping is first qualified.

claims: The owner carries nitrogen mass with NH4-N continuation provenance at the surface control volume.
The coordinate is mass per area rather than concentration.
The state remains representable without nonzero aqueous volume.
The owner is persistent state for conservation and restart, never an accounting residual.
nonclaims: No specific material phase is selected.
No specific molecular speciation is selected.
No counter-ion, hydration state, surface-binding state or phase fraction is selected.
No process law follows automatically from this identity envelope.

mass_state_restart.restart: Restore exact continuation mass; no hidden phase-memory is currently qualified.
mass_state_restart.future_transfer_rule: Any phase/species/owner reassignment requires a separately qualified typed transfer contract.

unlock_evidence: Provenanced theory or source evidence explicitly mapping continuation mass to a named material identity.
A separately authorized model-evolution material proposal with traceable identity evidence.
Observations that discriminate among competing continuation-material identities under the relevant dry-surface state.
next_handoff: Acquire or explicitly authorize candidate material-identity evidence before retrying dry-process or rewetting-process qualification.
